name: rightmove
description: Multi-server Rightmove monitor with per-server drawn-area searches, filters, safe reconciliation, persistent scheduling, reliable embeds, price ordering, and strict highlighting for permanently discounted outright-ownership homes, cancellable live scrapes, and safe per-server price-limit purging.
author: Five
install_msg: After loading, use `[p]rm setup #anchor <full Rightmove search URL>`. Use `[p]rm highlight reset` before setup to mark only First Homes and equivalent permanent-discount outright-ownership listings with a star; shared ownership and temporary incentives are never highlighted. Use `[p]rm purgeover <price>` to preview removal of accidentally imported over-limit properties.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-server configuration, Rightmove property metadata, Discord channel/message IDs, and scrape state. It does not store end-user personal data.
